messages.content: You help flood rescue teams read residents' clips.

content.text: A resident filmed this clip in a flooded street. Estimate the water depth range in metres where people and vehicles are, and say whether the water flows. Describe in one sentence what happens, in English (what_happens_en) and in Vietnamese (what_happens_local). Transcribe anything said on the audio in its own language (speech) and translate it to English (speech_en); both empty if nothing is said.

response.content: {"depth_m": {"high": 0.4, "low": 0.15}, "speech": "", "speech_en": "", "water_flow": "still", "what_happens_en": "A military truck carrying a rescue boat drives through a flooded street while residents wade through the water and ride motorbikes behind it as bystanders watch and film.", "what_happens_local": "Xe t\u1ea3i qu\u00e2n s\u1ef1 ch\u1edf thuy\u1ec1n c\u1ee9u h\u1ed9 ch\u1ea1y qua \u0111\u01b0\u1eddng ng\u1eadp trong khi ng\u01b0\u1eddi d\u00e2n l\u1ed9i n\u01b0\u1edbc v\u00e0 \u0111i xe m\u00e1y theo ph\u00eda sau c\u00f2n ng\u01b0\u1eddi xung quanh \u0111\u1ee9ng xem v\u00e0 quay phim."}
